senses.gloss: म (l) the consonant म् with the vowel अ added for facility of utterance; cf T. Pr. I.2.1 ; (2) The substitute म for मस् of the 1st pers. pl. in the perfect tense cf. P परस्मैपदानां ... णल्वमाः III. 4.82 and in the present tense also in the case of the root विद्; (3) tad. affix म added to the word मध्य in the Śaiṣika senses,and to the words द्यु and द्रु in the sense of possession; cf. P.IV.3.8,V.2. 108.
